title: брат in sentences
summary: The same forms in use. Read each sentence and choose the form that fits its gap: the words around it tell you the case and the number.

dat.sg.sentenceGloss: I am writing a letter to my brother.
dat.sg.note: Dative singular: the one it goes to. бра́ту is also right.

ins.sg.sentenceGloss: I am going with my brother.

loc.sg.sentenceGloss: My brother is wearing a new shirt.
loc.sg.note: Locative singular, after на. бра́ті is also right.

dat.pl.sentenceGloss: I am writing a letter to my brothers.
dat.pl.note: Dative plural: the one it goes to.

ins.pl.sentenceGloss: I am going with my brothers.

loc.pl.sentenceGloss: My brothers are wearing new shirts.
